_note: SANITIZED REAL PRODUCTION PANEL - the LINKED twin of real-vent-panel-example.json (same 360.001 Ventilasjon, exported AFTER hand-linking; plant prefix masked). THE reference for what a finished link looks like per object: driver_id = the full parameter string from iw_gen_driver_parameters (here NNNNN_OJEXHAUST_OJ_1_1_0_(2|4)_(param); _4_ = Analog values, _2_ = Digital IO/alarms), unit_id = the unit (V01), linked = "true", alias_text = the designer selector's "(Menu),-(parameter description)" text. EVERYTHING ELSE UNCHANGED: id stays literally "driver_id", link_name stays "link_name", link_tag/unit_ref stay empty. 57 of 102 objects linked; pipes/labels/arrows stay unlinked forever. Use together with driver-parameters-sample.sql (the dump such driver_id strings come from).
